UPSC Mains Result Out! After the declaration of the UPSC Civil Services Mains Written Examination Result, qualified candidates are now moving towards the next important stage – the UPSC Personality Test (Interview).

We will discuss the next stage of the UPSC Civil Services Examination, DAF (Detailed Application Form), Interview Preparation Strategy, Personality Test, Mock Interviews, Current Affairs, Educational Background, Home State, Hobbies and important questions related to your personal profile.

The UPSC Interview is not just a test of knowledge. It also evaluates your personality, communication skills, analytical thinking, decision-making ability and overall awareness.

Therefore, qualified candidates must start preparing with the right approach. Understanding the DAF, analysing your profile and practising through mock interviews are important steps towards effective preparation.

If you have qualified for the UPSC Mains Written Examination, this session will help you understand the next steps and build a structured roadmap for the Personality Test.

Watch the complete session and prepare confidently for the next stage of the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

Subscribe for UPSC Preparation, Current Affairs, Interview Guidance and State PCS Updates.
